Definition: Uzzi, the name of six Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Abishua begat Bukki, and Bukki begat Uzzi. Ezra's own line runs through Zerahiah, the son of Uzzi, the son of Bukki.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the priestly line is carried name by name for a reason: Uzzi stands between Bukki and Zerahiah on the road to Ezra, and the record links them so no one can doubt whose son the scribe was.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
